# HHLManyBody22.InspectBounds

**实际谱窗与inspection漏洞**

完整登记diagonal inspection与任意精度报告；用真实谱/行和证书校准可表示窗口，显式保留原不成立的无条件推断。

**边界**：PDF pp9–10 Eqs18–23 and FigA3 p22. In general diagonal max is a lower bound on spectral max, and diagonal min is an upper bound on spectral min; source implications run the wrong way. Diagonal dominance does not imply lambda_min>=d_min. With fixed dtilde, increasing nr alone fixes the longest scaled evolution time at order 1/dtilde and supplies no arbitrary-precision theorem.

**覆盖等级**：D
